rule_outs: Dwelling 6 m from the best section
summary: Tiny steep kerb on a narrow lane, with a house 6 m away.

drivers.seclusion: A detached house sits 6 m from the start of the kerb and others 12 and 22 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane with bush and steep bank beside it; no room to pull fully out of the lane.
drivers.convention: No signs; one or two cars parked further along the lane.

flags: Steep: about 15% mean grade, up to 17%
Dwelling within 10 m of the kerb
Narrow lane, tight for a van
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy over the kerb, shaded most of the day.
